summary: Injects a literal or protocol-supplied value into a theory graph.
claims: Provides an explicit external input boundary; it does not transform the supplied value.

summary: Applies a declared dense linear operator to a vector.
claims: Implements y = A x for a declared matrix A.

summary: Projects a vector into declared basis coordinates Q^T x.
claims: Makes coordinate choice explicit so basis-aligned and arbitrary-coordinate mechanisms can be compared.

summary: Persistent matrix state updated by addressed rank-1 writes; later probes are transformed by the accumulated operator.
claims: Provides a deterministic calibration mechanism in which two addressed persistent writes can compose noncommutatively.
The frozen parameter is a destructive control: writes are observed but do not alter the resident operator.

provenance.source: Inspired by the operator-composition abstraction; not a biological model

summary: Reports Euclidean/Frobenius norm of a scalar, vector, or matrix.
claims: Provides a bounded scalar measurement without changing the upstream state.

summary: Computes L2/Frobenius magnitude of the difference between two compatible values.
claims: Turns a paired difference into an explicit scalar diagnostic.
